author: KEXP
description: Hailing from Gothenburg, Sweden, doom trio MONOLORD make their way to the KEXP Live Room with a heavy sound steeped in repetition and volume. With host Tanner Ellison, the band share a performance of "You Bastard" and more.
title: MONOLORD performs "You Bastard" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
